raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Motivation

@humansand

Use FlashInfer's explicit 4over6 API for online NVFP4 weight conversion, preserving the recipe pinned by #33621 while moving quantization settings into the online quantizer.

## Modifications

- **Recipe:** pass `NVFP44Over6Config(e4m3_max=448, err_mode="MSE", err_use_fast_math=True)` to `nvfp4_quantize(..., nvfp4_4over6=...)`; remove the four load-time 4over6 environment overrides.
- **Scale contract:** derive the E4M3 maximum from that same config. Preserve the existing per-tensor decode-scale arithmetic, zero-amax handling, and shared w1/w3 scale.
- **Ownership:** keep the exact-FP4-math environment scope in the online quantizer. A small reference-counted context reuses `temp_set_env`: the first caller sets the override, and the last caller restores the original value, including on exceptions. The lock covers only entry/exit bookkeeping; quantizer calls run concurrently.
- **Scope:** the shared helper covers `nvfp4_online` and nonserialized `modelopt_fp4` MoE weights. Keep the new FlashInfer import lazy. The generic loader retains its post-load CUDA synchronization/cache cleanup; activation recipe selection is unchanged. The monokernel weight observer still runs before `model.load_weights`; upstream FlashRL reload guards and ModelOpt layout/padding handling are preserved.

### Dependencies

- **Required API:** [flashinfer-ai/flashinfer#5152](https://github.com/flashinfer-ai/flashinfer/pull/5152), merged as [`7bcf91831e4640cf7b8983e8b7954e94a03746b3`](https://github.com/flashinfer-ai/flashinfer/commit/7bcf91831e4640cf7b8983e8b7954e94a03746b3).
- **Behavior baseline:** [sgl-project/sglang#33621](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/33621), which pinned 448 / MSE / fast candidate-error evaluation for online weights.
- **Dependency satisfied:** [sgl-project/sglang#43494](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/43494) pins [FlashInfer v0.7.1](https://github.com/flashinfer-ai/flashinfer/releases/tag/v0.7.1), which includes the required API. Use that upstream pin; this PR adds no package-pin changes or legacy fallback. The separate `FLASHINFER_DISABLE_FP4_QUANT_FAST_MATH` flag remains environment-based in 0.7.1.

## Accuracy Tests

Not run, per request. No runtime/numerical parity or GPU validation was performed.

Static checks only, on macOS at commit `b75e623908bd5bfcb87161de87af7cd42eee7ec1`, based on upstream `4cca7fcd3e644f22a61c7a6e6b57bb89b568d62a`, using the repository's pinned Ruff 0.15.1 and isort 7.0.0. Source review covered the monokernel observer, InstantTensor input path, FP8 reload guards, ModelOpt MegaMoE W13 layout/TRTLLM padding, and concurrent/direct weight reload paths. The online quantizer is byte-identical to the prior PR head; all upstream loader code outside the intended environment-scope removal is retained.

```bash
files=(python/sglang/srt/layers/quantization/nvfp4_online.py python/sglang/srt/model_loader/loader.py)
uvx --from ruff==0.15.1 ruff format --check "${files[@]}"
uvx --from ruff==0.15.1 ruff check --select F401,F821,F823,UP037 "${files[@]}"
uvx --from isort==7.0.0 isort --check-only "${files[@]}"
python3 - <<'PY'
import ast
from pathlib import Path
for name in ('python/sglang/srt/layers/quantization/nvfp4_online.py', 'python/sglang/srt/model_loader/loader.py'):
    ast.parse(Path(name).read_text(), filename=name)
    print(f'AST parse passed: {name}')
PY
git diff --check 4cca7fcd3e644f22a61c7a6e6b57bb89b568d62a...HEAD
```

Complete static-check output (all exited 0; isort and `git diff --check` were silent):

```text
2 files already formatted
All checks passed!
AST parse passed: python/sglang/srt/layers/quantization/nvfp4_online.py
AST parse passed: python/sglang/srt/model_loader/loader.py
```

## Speed Tests and Profiling

Not run, per request. Load-time performance is unmeasured.

## Checklist

- [ ] Format your code according to the [Format code with pre-commit](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#format-code-with-pre-commit). (Pinned Ruff/isort checks passed; full pre-commit was not run.)
- [ ] Add unit tests according to the [Run and add unit tests](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#run-and-add-unit-tests). (No test changes.)
- [ ] Update documentation according to [Write documentations](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#write-documentations). (No public SGLang interface change.)
- [ ] Provide accuracy and speed benchmark results according to [Test the accuracy](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#test-the-accuracy) and [Benchmark the speed](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#benchmark-the-speed). (Not run, per request.)
- [x] Follow the SGLang code style [guidance](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#code-style-guidance).

## Review and Merge Process

1. Ping Merge Oncalls to start the process. See the [PR Merge Process](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/blob/main/.github/MAINTAINER.md#pull-request-merge-process).
2. Get approvals from [CODEOWNERS](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/blob/main/.github/CODEOWNERS) and other reviewers.
3. Trigger CI tests with [comments](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#how-to-trigger-ci-tests) or contact authorized users to do so.
   - Common commands include `/tag-and-rerun-ci`, `/tag-run-ci-label`, `/rerun-failed-ci`
4. After green CI and required approvals, ask Merge Oncalls or people with Write permission to merge the PR.
